messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "4 weeks after starting"
set: ["4 weeks after starting", "87% after 4 weeks", "children tested 2 and 4 weeks after starting treatment", "4 weeks after each dose change", "assess LDL-C as early as 4 weeks after initiating", "94% after 8 weeks", "97% after 8 weeks", "increase to 5 mg subcutaneously once a week after 4 weeks", "about 4 hours after taking", "wait at least 2 weeks after stopping an MAOI before starting fluoxetine", "4 to 6 weeks for full effects", "increase dosage to 0.5 mg once weekly after 4 weeks on 0.25 mg", "wait at least 5 weeks after stopping fluoxetine before starting an MAOI or thioridazine", "increase in 2.5 mg increments after at least 4 weeks on the current dose", "20.9% or 48.6 lb after 72 weeks", "reassess blood pressure after a few weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
